name: Kurabayashi Tsukuko
source:
[u][b]The Girl Who Can "See Them."[/b][/u]
[b]SR Evaluation Value: 7/10[/b]
Occupation: Second-year student
Height: About average
Bust: Large

A girl who "sees things." What exactly? Ghosts. Because of this, her daily life is full of struggles. She isn’t naturally a gloomy person, but due to her unique ability, she has spent most of her time with her head down, avoiding others.
The truth is, when she smiles, she’s incredibly cute, but she hasn’t been able to truly laugh.
To come to terms with her ability and be able to smile honestly, she must "grow." It was at that moment that she encountered the [url=/c150333]protagonist[/url], who had just arrived at the academy.

[i]What kind of girl is she?[/i]
She is always looking down, which at first glance makes her seem gloomy. However, this is only because she is troubled by the ghosts she can see. In reality, she is a bright and kind-hearted girl.

「I can see them anytime, anywhere...」
